windows.reason: the interior is shut for winter - F-roads stay closed until the snow has melted and the ground has dried enough; even the earliest opening in 2021-2025 came in late May
opening in stages: F208 to Landmannalaugar has opened between late May and late June (on average 2 June over 2021-2025), and other roads follow into July
every road in the road administration's table has opened by mid-July, and the second half of July is when essentially every F-road is open at once
the main highland roads are open; autumn closures come from September onward
roads close when autumn weather makes them impassable, which can happen any time from September onward and abruptly after a single storm; check the official road status the morning you drive

activities.name: Natural ice caves (Vatnajokull)
activities.note: the natural caves melt and become unsafe outside the cold months; the year-round man-made ice tunnel is a different trip

windows.reason: the park names November to March as the best time to visit, and the ice is at its most stable in mid-winter
the edges of the season: tours to the natural caves run October to April, but the caves form in different places each year and October's ice is the least stable

activities.name: Puffin colonies
activities.note: the puffin spends about eight months a year out at sea; by early October nearly all have left the coast

windows.reason: the puffins are ashore to nest, and May to mid-August is the best time to see them; boat tours to the colonies run from early May
the first birds arrive on the cliffs and islands in late April
the tail of the season: tours run until mid-August, and the birds head back out to sea by mid-to-late August

activities.name: Laugavegur trek
activities.note: the huts along the trail are closed and locked in winter

windows.reason: the trail's huts are open and staffed by a warden through the summer
the edges of the season: the huts open on average around 25 June, once the road administration opens the Fjallabak roads, and close around mid-September

activities.name: Northern lights
activities.note: from May to August the sky does not get dark enough to see them

windows.reason: the longest nights give the widest viewing window
from September through April the sky gets dark enough for aurora viewing

activities.name: Þjóðhátíð (Westman Islands festival)
activities.note: in some years the weekend begins in the last days of July

windows.reason: held in Herjólfsdalur on Heimaey over the weekend before the first Monday in August
